products.name: Commercial-to-GCC High Microsoft 365 & Azure Migration Program — Commercial
products.short_description: The complete program playbook to move an entire commercial Microsoft 365 + Azure estate to GCC High — Exchange, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Azure IaaS servers, apps, and AVD/VDI — as a coordinated, cross-cloud, workstream-by-workstream migration driven by Quest On Demand, ShareGate, and Azure Migrate/ASR. Phased, validated, fixed price.
products.description:
One coordinated program to reach the sovereign cloud — every workstream, in the right order

Moving to GCC High is not an in-place upgrade — it is a separate sovereign cloud, so it requires a brand-new GCC High tenant and a cross-cloud migration of your whole estate, under eligibility validation (DoD/DIB, ITAR/EAR, CMMC, FedRAMP-High drivers) and an authorized AOS-G partner. Done piecemeal, the workstreams collide: identity, mail, files, Teams, servers, apps, and virtual desktops each have their own cutover and their own failure modes. This solution is the program playbook that sequences them all — Discover → Assess → Plan → Provision → Pilot → Migrate → Cutover → Validate → Decommission — with a named runbook for every workstream.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a six-figure systems-integrator engagement to run the plan. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation your program lead and admins execute end to end — with full GCC High .us navigation paths — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell (Microsoft Graph, Exchange Online, and Az with sovereign-cloud endpoints) for discovery, validation, status reporting, wave planning, and safe remediation.

  • Simpler — one program model coordinating seven workstreams; every object you create (resource groups, ASR vault, migration projects, waves, connectors) is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open SI meter. A comparable GCC High migration program runs well into six figures; this is a fraction of that, and reusable across the estate.
  • Tested — a pilot-by-workstream method with explicit pass/fail gates and per-workstream acceptance gates (mail flow, content parity, Teams, server failover boot + app validation, AVD session + profile) before each cutover.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the cross-cloud program model, the seven workstreams, the GCC-High-is-a-separate-cloud reality, and tooling (Quest On Demand, ShareGate, Azure Migrate + ASR, native).
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (GCC High eligibility + Microsoft validation/sponsorship, AOS-G reseller, provisioned GCC High tenant + Azure Government subscription, dual-cloud admin, migration accounts, tooling licensing, network, identity plan, DNS control, ITAR/compliance controls) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing — plus the category Global Requirements.
  • Program Runbook — discover/assess the estate, plan waves, provision the GCC High tenant + Azure Gov landing zone, then per-workstream runbooks for Exchange, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Azure IaaS (Azure Migrate + ASR), Azure apps/PaaS, and AVD/VDI (host pools + FSLogix), then cutover, validate, and decommission.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — estate discovery (M365 + Azure), GCC High readiness + per-workstream cutover validation, program/workstream status reporting, safe remediation, and a wave/workstream planner — all using sovereign-cloud endpoint switches.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with per-workstream gates, plus Best Practices (wave planning, compliance/ITAR handling, ASR test failovers, FSLogix, decommission discipline, CMMC evidence).

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so a program this large stays familiar and low-risk — run it once, and reuse the model for the next sovereign-cloud move or acquisition integration.

The bottom line

An entire commercial M365 + Azure estate migrated to a GCC High sovereign tenant — identity, mail, files, Teams, servers, apps, and virtual desktops — coordinated as one program, validated workstream by workstream, on a fixed budget your team controls.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GCCHIGH-Discovery.ps1 — Read-only estate inventory of a commercial Microsoft 365 + Azure tenant
    • GCCHIGH-Remediation.ps1 — Safe remediation helpers for a Commercial-to-GCC High migration
    • GCCHIGH-Report.ps1 — Program / workstream status report for a Commercial-to-GCC High migration
    • GCCHIGH-Set-WavePlan.ps1 — Generate / validate a migration wave + workstream plan from discovery
    • GCCHIGH-Validation.ps1 — GCC High target readiness + per-workstream cutover validation (PASS/FAIL)

Delivered as a branded-free Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across the estate.
